captions.instagram:
Business meal or holiday party? The deduction isn't the same.

✔️ Business meals, like lunch with a client, are generally 50% deductible.
✔️ A holiday party or picnic held mainly for your employees is an exception to the 50% limit.
✔️ For every meal: keep the receipt, note who was there and the business reason, and log it the same week.

Our Tax Write Offs Tracker keeps receipts, mileage, home office and more in one workbook, with a year-end summary for your tax preparer.

sources.fact: You can deduct no more than $25 for business gifts to each person during your tax year; generally only 50% of business meal expenses unless an exception applies; employer recreational, social or similar activities (e.g., holiday parties, summer picnics) are excepted from the 50% limit (Pub 463, 2025); read 2026-10-30
